## ✅ Updating

Taktwin updates itself. It looks for a new version when it starts, and **Settings → Updates** shows it: click **Download and install**, then **Restart now**. Your stations, programs and collections stay where they are, in your Taktwin folder.

Taktwin 0.1.0 does not update itself yet: install {tag} over it, from the files below.

> [!NOTE]
> Collections update on their own: import the new `.taktwin` file in **Settings → Collections**, and it replaces the old one.

## 📦 Installing

The app is not signed yet, so the system warns the first time.

- **Windows:** run `Taktwin-{version}-windows-x64-setup.exe`. It installs for your user only, without administrator rights. When SmartScreen says "Windows protected your PC", choose **More info → Run anyway**. `Taktwin-{version}-windows-x64.exe` runs without installing.
- **macOS** (Apple silicon and Intel): open `Taktwin-{version}-macos-universal.dmg` and drag Taktwin into Applications. On first start macOS refuses to open it: open **System Settings → Privacy & Security** and click **Open Anyway** beside Taktwin, or run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Taktwin.app`.

`SHA256SUMS` lists the checksums of the files.
